note: SYNTHETIC. Six invented sessions, generated by a seeded program from made-up event grammars: calls and results, snapshot markers, a few destructive-command flags, stops and notes. No real session, project, path or transcript text is in it. Each row of a session is one `{seq, kind, text, risk}` event as the level-of-detail transform reads it: a tool_call or tool_result keeps its tool token and outcome label, a snapshot keeps its tree marker, and every other kind keeps only its kind. Sessions 5e5a0001 to 5e5a0004 hold snapshot markers; 5e5a0005 and 5e5a0006 are shaped like legacy imports, with no snapshots and every result recording its tool as `unknown`. `cards` is the number of event rows in the session. Sequence numbers are sparse and global, as in a real record.
